```{r}
# Data is prepared by render_report_pdf() in helpers.R
library(ggplot2)
rep <- readRDS("report.rds")
fmt_date <- rep$fmt_date
fmt <- function(df) {
  df[] <- lapply(df, function(x) if (inherits(x, "Date")) fmt_date(x) else x)
  df
}
```

# `r rep$athlete`

**Squad:** `r rep$squad` · **Test:** `r rep$test` · **Generated:** `r fmt_date(rep$generated)`

**Setup:** `r rep$setup_txt`

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(rep$sessions) == 0) cat("*No results recorded for this test yet.*")
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(rep$sessions) > 0) {
  cat("## Summary\n\n")
  print(knitr::kable(rep$summary, align = c("l", "c", "c")))
  cat("\n\n## Peak force over time\n\n")
}
```

```{r}
#| fig-width: 7
#| fig-height: 3.2
if (nrow(rep$sessions) > 0) print(rep$plot)
```

```{r}
#| results: asis
if (nrow(rep$sessions) > 0) {
  cat("## Sessions (best trial per limb)\n\n")
  # "simple" format: a pipe table would escape the "|" in Trials and stretch to full width
  print(knitr::kable(fmt(rep$table), format = "simple", align = c("l", "r", "r", "r", "r", "c", "r")))
}
```
